metadata.description: Source-linked directory of real Indian higher-education institutions for education discovery, institution search and directory linking.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify institution identity, official website, current course availability, recognition, admission eligibility and other time-sensitive claims using the relevant official institution or regulatory source before relying on them.
notes: This dataset is an institution directory and is not a complete national register of all Indian colleges and universities.
An official website reference does not independently verify current course availability, accreditation, regulatory approval, admission eligibility, fees, rankings or seat counts.
Institution types describe broad categories and must not be interpreted as a current accreditation or approval status.
Use the relevant regulator or admission authority for course-specific and admission-cycle-specific claims.
Confirm each official website URL and institution details before production publication.
Unknown facts must not be fabricated. Add optional fields only when supported by appropriate sources.
Keep stable record IDs when correcting institution names or website URLs.
The dataset contains directory references, not current admission notices or live seat availability.
